scope: Finite pose intersections of new moving lever/cap/hardware and core, exact new body material, nonmount input fixed metal, and an equal-length route family against explicitly listed current local host. Not full continuous motion or an unsupported real hose shape guarantee.
body_partition: body_growth is exact Boolean candidate body minus official ci_body. No mount contact surfaces are removed by tolerance. Existing body remaining inside baseline is outside this added-material check. Symmetric cover differences are checked empty.
intentional_mates: Own steel core is excluded from housing collisions. Moving/core separately tested so core is not intersected with its own housing. Mount bolts omitted only from nonmount metal check; existing thread engagement is not re-certified. Full route 1mm envelope excludes first/last15mm and third-arc retainer; nominal OD5 housing is independently intersected with full retainer at all delta samples. Retainer 6.2 bore is expected to be within inflated OD7 clearance, so inflated-route/retainer overlap is not called a collision.
unverified: baseline remaining input body contact acceptance is inherited and not re-certified
